title: Glorious Memories
start: Speak to Manni the Reveller inside the longhall in Rellekka.

requirements.t: Standard spells equipped or the ability to cast Spellbook Swap

items.t: 10 earth runes or a magic weapon which provides earth runes, such as a staff of earth
Staff or pole (can be obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Miscellania Teleport or a Ring of Wealth (or its higher-tier variants) for quick teleports to King Vargas
Multiple ways to teleport around the Fremennik Province:
House Teleport runes or a Rellekka tablet with a home in Rellekka
Dramen/Lunar staff (not necessary if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift quest is completed)

kills.t: Nial Swiftfling (Level 81) (attacks with melee and ranged)

rewards.t: 15000 Combat XP tome (3x 5000 Combat XP) in either Attack, Strength, Constitution, Defence, or Ranged (Skill must be level 40 or higher)
An unfinished astral rune that can be traded with Baba Yaga for extra rewards

steps.t: Talk to Manni the Reveller in Rellekka longhall. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to King Vargas in Miscellania.
Talk to Manni the Reveller in Rellekka longhall.
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain back in Rellekka Longhall. [Chat: # Ask about the birthday feast.]
After the cutscene you'll be given cave directions.
Then return to Miscellania and talk to King Vargas.
After the cutscene, talk to Mawnis Burowgar in Neitiznot, south of the bank. [Chat: 2 Chieftain Brundt's birthday feast.] Watch the cutscene.
Travel to the 'i' icon ('question mark' on legacy interfaces) in the snowy Rellekka Hunter area.

Inspect the tracks in the north-west corner of the platform and follow them to a mound of ice in the north-east corner. Inspect the tracks directly in front of the ice mound, then dig through the ice mound and go inside. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: If you are unable to see the tracks, you may lower your graphical settings and/or lower your brightness settings.

steps.t: Run to the southern wall and enter the tunnel.
Kill Nial Swiftfling and take all of his items.
Talk to Freygerd in Jatizso near the west gate. [Chat: 1 Talk about Nial.]
Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the central building. [Chat: 2 Talk about Freygerd and the new tax.]
Talk to Freygerd near the west gate. [Chat: 1 Talk about Nial.]
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar in Neitiznot, south of the bank. [Chat: 2 Chieftain Brundt's birthday feast.]
Ensure you have the standard spellbook enabled.
Travel to the Mountain Camp. (Fairy code AJR or east of the Fremennik Province lodestone.)

sub.t: A pole and plank can be found near the goats if you didn't bring a staff and plank.

steps.t: Climb the tree next to the lake, use the staff/pole on the clump of rocks, then use the plank on the flat stone.
Stand south of the rocks and listen-to a shining pool in the water.

sub.t: If the diamond root was not placed in your backpack, open the herb pouch with at least one available backpack space.

steps.t: Use your vial on the spring that appeared on the rock near you.
Use a clean irit on the vial of mountain water for a mountain irit potion (unfinished).
Grind the diamond root, cast Lvl-4 Enchant on the diamond root dust, then use the enchanted diamond root dust and yeti hair to the unfinished vial to make yeti curse cure.
Return and talk to King Vargas. After the cutscene, he transforms into his human form.
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the Rellekka longhall about the birthday feast. [Chat: # Ask about the birthday feast.]
After the cutscene, talk to Manni the Reveller in the longhall and watch another cutscene.
Quest complete!
Optionally after the quest:

sub.t: Take the unfinished astral rune to Baba Yaga on Lunar Isle. [Chat: 2 Talk about astral runes.]
Take the prophecy tablet to Historian Minas on the floor 2 of the Varrock Museum. [Chat: 2 I have some information that might be of use in your displays.]
